scope: OMP 18.1.4 native marketplace command discovery. This is a bounded read/probe for the manual-only skill to slash-command conversion question; it does not authorize another distribution route.

isolation.retention_reason: The terminal guard rejected the requested recursive temporary-directory cleanup. The retained path is isolated evidence; do not treat it as an installed plugin or retry cleanup as part of this finding.

fixture.command_body: Run explicit bridge for $1; all=$ARGUMENTS; resource=resources/example.txt.

actual_invocation: HOME=<temporary> PI_CONFIG_DIR=.omp-probe omp plugin marketplace add <temporary>/market --json
HOME=<temporary> PI_CONFIG_DIR=.omp-probe omp plugin install manual-bridge@audit --scope user --json
HOME=<temporary> PI_CONFIG_DIR=.omp-probe bun -e '<import discovery/index.ts; loadSlashCommands; expandSlashCommand>'

command_loader.finding: The OMP extension provider would read commands/*.md and derive a slash-command name from its filename.

marketplace_exclusion.finding: Before the OMP extension provider receives roots, it removes every path already identified as a marketplace root.

marketplace_surface.finding: The Agent Plugins marketplace provider declares and loads only skills and MCP; it has no command capability registration.

hybrid_rule.finding: A valid Agent Plugin may expose client-specific 'other' surfaces only through a legacy provider, but that permission does not bypass marketplace-root exclusion.

would_be_command_semantics.finding: For a command that is actually discovered, OMP preserves its filename-derived name, parses description/body, and expands $1/$ARGUMENTS.

limits.manual_only_mapping: unsupported for a marketplace-installed Agent Plugin: commands/*.md never reaches OMP's slash-command loader.
limits.resources: No command resource binding was found. The loaded FileSlashCommand retains only name, description, content, source, and source metadata; skill containment/resource handling does not transfer to commands.
limits.not_an_alternate_route: Configured extension packages may use commands/, but that is not marketplace installation and is outside this conversion scope.
limits.required_change: An OMP native source change is required to include marketplace roots in a command provider and define command-resource semantics.

decision: Do not convert a manual-only skill to a native OMP marketplace slash command, and do not strip disable-model-invocation. This is an unsupported native marketplace capability, not an adapter gap that can be safely projected.
